Container.Name: HashHive
Container.Overview: Unified mining dashboard for NMMiner, Bitaxe and NerdAxe devices. It provides live statistics, device configuration, pool management, alerting and notifications through Telegram, Discord or Gotify.
Container.Requires: The host port is 80, which assumes this container gets its own address from a custom network such as br0. On the default bridge network Unraid's own web interface holds port 80, so change the WebUI Port below before starting it there.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the HashHive web interface.

Config.Name: Data Volume
Config.Description: Persistent configuration, alerts, device state and logs.
